title: Development of PdO/Sr3Fe2O7−δ/α-Al2O3 catalysts for methane combustion
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21229-21239
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02851E, Paper

Herein, the results of our study suggest that αwt%PdO/16wt%Sr3Fe2O7−δ/α-Al2O3 catalysts are promising next-generation candidates for advanced methane decomposition.
